name: LionCircuits Fabrication Export
description: Generate Gerbers, drill files, BOM, position file, IPC-D-356 netlist, and interactive BOM in one click.
description_full: LionCircuits adds a single toolbar button to the PCB Editor. Clicking it exports Gerbers and Excellon drill files (LionCircuits' fab-ready naming standard), a BOM for assembly, a BOM for components (supplier quote/procurement), a component position (CPL) file, an IPC-D-356 bare-board test netlist, and an interactive HTML BOM (using InteractiveHtmlBom if installed, otherwise a built-in fallback table). Gerbers and drill files are optionally zipped into a fab-ready package.
